arms.D: Same C evidence plus deterministic state projection and applicability guidance

scorer: personamem-v2-inference-d29d91d; unchanged ordered regex and first match; bare letter invalid
completed_definition: B validated returned output (EOS or length finish). Parse invalid is a completed model response, never a transport failure. Length stops remain scored without trimming or answer repair, with separate counts and EOS-only sensitivity.
result_selection: First technically validated successful result for each exact request; never choose the best answer. Retry failures only. Exact reuse is not an independent observation.
structural_definition: C/D not_evaluable iff original direct_status != located_unique; no other failure may be reclassified as structural; exclude structural slots from evaluable denominators.
reports: For every cell report planned slots, predefined evaluable N, structural N, technically completed N/rate, attempted N, physical attempts/retries, technical failures by class, parse invalid, valid wrong, correct, length stops.
Official accuracy on completed responses (parse invalid counts incorrect), with N and Wilson 95% CI.

Sensitivity: correct/predefined evaluable N treating all uncompleted evaluable slots as zero successes; not a claim that unexecuted or technical failures are wrong answers. Also show unknown-outcome bounds.
A/B all240; A/B/C/D direct207; A/B direct_missing33. No cross-arm comparison between unequal task sets.
Separate representative180 and hard60; each fixed hard stratum15; category intersections. No natural prevalence inference from the enriched hard sample.
Explicit nonrandom Direct missingness table. Sensitive C/D ability is unmeasured, not zero.
Four-arm common-completed table per model and eight-cell common-completed table across models, in addition to pairwise complete-case comparisons. Retain planned207 denominator in each.

Cross-model comparisons use identical task IDs completed by both, never subtract unpaired marginal accuracies. Report complete pairs, missing pairs, repair, regression, unchanged, paired difference and CI.

paired_inference.difference: right minus left, computed on both-completed identical tasks; parse-invalid responses remain in pairs
paired_inference.cluster: persona_group; one task per persona in this frozen sample
paired_inference.ci: 95% percentile persona-cluster paired bootstrap; unadjusted descriptive intervals
paired_inference.multiplicity: Exact two-sided McNemar/binomial on discordant complete pairs; Holm adjustment across the fixed 8 primary comparisons. Other groups/contrasts descriptive only.
paired_inference.sensitivity: Same fixed evaluable task set with uncompleted outcomes counted as zero successes, plus worst/best unknown-outcome paired bounds; do not call these capability repairs/regressions. EOS-only pairs separately.
paired_inference.no_claim: Development sample only. No equivalence, noninferiority, natural prevalence, independent temporal-memory, autonomous need-identification or open-generation quality claim.

attribution.A_to_B: Value of this long-history retrieval treatment relative to recent window, not memory versus no memory.
attribution.B_to_C: Join actual delivered IDs/hashes to full Direct references; distinguish absent user evidence, absent assistant/reference context, and all-reference-delivered cases. Full user coverage alone does not prove evidence sufficiency. Noise/use attribution remains diagnostic without a matched-noise intervention.
attribution.C_to_D: Joint increment of deterministic state projection plus usage guidance with identical original evidence; report both generators separately and agreement of effect directions.
attribution.error_review: Review all complete C/D errors and paired B-to-C/C-to-D discordances, using fixed categories and source traces. Keep quoted output/evidence private. Separate observable errors from speculative causes; ambiguous cases stay unresolved.
attribution.WP3: Choose one largest supported repair opportunity after full results, accounting for uncertainty, technical loss and subgroup harms. Training only if a real utilization gap and lawful train supervision support it; no training authorization.

interim: Sealed snapshots may be checked for technical integrity during inference; no interim accuracy-driven changes to conditions, prompts, budgets, parser, sample or primary metrics.
privacy: Only code, rules, hashes, aggregate statistics and non-identifying analysis on GitHub. Raw tasks, answers, outputs, per-task records and weights remain local.
